'''Bev Vincent''' is an essayist author of fiction and a literary critic, he also is the author of ''The Road to the Dark Tower'' and ''The Stephen King Illustrated Companion.''

==Selected bibliography==
*''The Road to the Dark Tower'' (2005, [[Cemetery Dance Publications]]) (illustrated by [[Glenn Chadbourne]]) {{ISBN|1-58767-104-2}}<ref>{{Cite web|title=Nonfiction Book Review: The Road to the Dark Tower: Exploring Stephen King's Magnum Opus by Bev Vincent, Author, Stephen King, Introduction by, Stephen King, With New American Library $16 (368p) {{text|ISBN}} 978-0-451-21304-4|url=https://www.publishersweekly.com/978-0-451-21304-4|access-date=2021-08-30|website=PublishersWeekly.com|language=en}}</ref>
*''The Good, The Bad, & The Ugly: Eight Secondary Characters from the Dark Tower Series'' ([[The Quarto Group|2005]], Cemetery Dance Publications) (illustrated by [[Glenn Chadbourne]]). Part of a free promotion.
*''The Illustrated Stephen King Trivia Book'' (2005, Cemetery Dance Publications) - Co-edited by [[Brian James Freeman|Brian Freeman]] and illustrated by [[Glenn Chadbourne]] {{ISBN|1-58767-116-6}}<ref>{{Cite web|title=SF/Fantasy/Horror Notes|url=https://www.publishersweekly.com/pw/print/20050530/38535-sf-fantasy-horror-notes.html|access-date=2021-08-30|website=PublishersWeekly.com|language=en}}</ref>
*''The Stephen King Illustrated Companion'' (2009, [[Fall River Press]]) {{ISBN|1-4351-1766-2}}
*''The Dark Tower Companion'' (2013, New American Library) {{ISBN|0451237994}}<ref>{{Cite web |date=2013-02-13 |title=The Dark Tower Companion: A Guide to Stephen King's Epic Fantasy by Bev Vincent |url=https://www.thisishorror.co.uk/read-horror/book-reviews/dark-tower-companion-guide-stephen-kings-epic-fantasy-bev-vincent/ |access-date=2023-01-04 |website=This Is Horror |language=en-GB}}</ref>
*''[[Flight or Fright]]'' (2018, Cemetery Dance Publications / Hodder & Stoughton) : an anthology co-edited by [[Stephen King]]) {{ISBN|978-1-58767-679-6}}<ref>{{Cite web|title=Fiction Book Review: Flight or Fright by Edited by Stephen King and Bev Vincent. Cemetery Dance, $27.95 (336p) {{text|ISBN}} 978-1-58767-679-6|url=https://www.publishersweekly.com/978-1-58767-679-6|access-date=2021-08-30|website=PublishersWeekly.com|language=en}}</ref>
*The short story ''Bloody Sunday'' found in ''The Book of Extraordinary New Sherlock Holmes Stories: The Best New Original Stories of the Genre'' {{ISBN|978-1-64250-432-3}} <ref>{{Cite web|title=Mystery/Thriller Book Review: The Book of Extraordinary New Sherlock Holmes Stories: The Best New Original Stories of the Genre by Edited by Maxim Jakubowski. Mango, $18.95 trade paper (284p) {{text|ISBN}} 978-1-64250-432-3|url=https://www.publishersweekly.com/978-1-64250-432-3|access-date=2021-08-30|website=PublishersWeekly.com|language=en}}</ref>
*''Blaze of Glory'' (2021, short story, Budgie Smuggler Games, Voices of Varuna: A [[Renegade Legion]] Anthology)
*''Stephen King: A Complete Exploration of His Work, Life, and Influences'' (2022, [[The Quarto Group|Quarto]]) {{ISBN|978-0-7603-7681-2}}<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-11-23 |title=Alvaro Zinos-Amaro Reviews Stephen King: A Complete Exploration of His Work, Life and Influences by Bev Vincent |url=https://locusmag.com/2022/11/alvaro-zinos-amaro-reviews-stephen-king-a-complete-exploration-of-his-work-life-and-influences-by-bev-vincent/ |access-date=2023-01-04 |website=Locus Online |language=en-US}}</ref>
